battle.name: 隋擊流求之戰
battle.brief: 大業六年（610年），隋煬帝遣武衛將軍陳棱、虎威將軍劉寶、周師將軍朱智良，率五萬五千人自廣州浮海東渡攻琉球國。隋軍以弩陣與盾兵壓住島民，強登灘頭破城，擒國主、俘虜二萬餘人。近戰靠環首直刀：與本卡的羅馬短劍同族，靠盾邊與刺突節奏取勝，不靠揮砍。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 隋朝一方由隋煬帝楊廣下詔，以天子的名義發動遠征；行軍最高統帥是武衛將軍陳棱，副手是虎威將軍劉寶與周師將軍朱智良，三人各領一部宿衛府兵與募兵。部隊骨幹是京師禁軍中調出的武衛、虎威、周師等府兵，另有郡縣募兵與南朝降將所部，總數為將兵及募降卒五萬五千人；隨軍有水軍船隊、船工與糧秣隊，後勤由番禺、始安一帶的郡倉供應，指揮則歸行軍總督府節制。流求國一方以島上國主與各部首長為核心，王權之下分居數十處聚落，平日沒有常備軍，只在戰時臨時集合步卒，使用木盾、竹矛、弓矢與投石，未見成建制的金屬甲兵。島上各部族分立，沒有中原式的郡縣與徵發制度，調兵完全依靠國主與酋長的號令，因此是一支臨時拼湊、缺乏統一號令的島民武裝，而不是常備軍。隋軍的船隊編制、糧秣徵發與賞罰都依行軍總督府的文書執行，島方則沒有相應的後勤與指揮機關，這一差距在登岸之後迅速顯現。
countriesEn: Two sides faced one another in 610. On the Sui side, Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, issued the order in his own name as Son of Heaven, and the expedition was led by General of the Martial Guard Chen Leng, with General of the Tiger's Might Liu Bao and General of the Zhou Division Zhu Zhiliang commanding subordinate formations. The troops drew their backbone from the rotating garrison units of the capital, the Martial Guard, the Tiger's Might, the Zhou Division and other palace guards, supplemented by provincial recruits and the men of Southern Chen officers who had surrendered to Sui. The whole force numbered about 55,000 men in arms and recruited levies; a supporting flotilla, the crews who manned it, and the baggage and grain trains travelled with it. Supply was drawn from the commandery granaries around Panyu and Shian in the south, and the whole operation was run through the travelling headquarters of a military directorate. On the Ryukyu side, power centred on the island king and the heads of the island's communities. Ryukyu kept no standing army in the Chinese sense: its people lived in a number of scattered coastal settlements, and on the alarm they were hastily mustered into a body of foot soldiers carrying wooden shields, bamboo lances, bows and thrown stones, with no organised armour in evidence. The island's communities were not welded into prefectures and counties, and no system of conscription existed; the raising of men rested entirely on the personal authority of the king and of the local headmen. What the Sui fleet faced was therefore a hastily mustered island militia under royal command, not a field army in the Roman or Chinese sense. The manning of the Sui flotilla, the requisition of grain and the discipline of the army were all run on paper issued by the travelling headquarters; the island side had no matching apparatus of supply and command, and that gap opened up as soon as the troops were ashore.
people: 下詔出兵的是隋煬帝楊廣。此時他剛在張掖、焉支山接見西域諸國的使者，又在營建東都與大運河，接著把兵鋒指向高句麗，遠征流求在他心裡是一場可以用來宣示天威的勝利。主帥陳棱原為南朝陳的將領，陳亡後歸隋，歷官武衛將軍，這一次由他統率海陸大軍並率隊登岸；虎威將軍劉寶與周師將軍朱智良同樣是南朝歸隋的老將，分領所部配合船隊轉運。島方的主事者是琉球國主與島上各部首長，《隋書》只記隋軍擒其國主，並沒有留下國主的名諱；抵抗過程中，國主與一批首長陣亡或被俘。這場戰役裡更大量的是沒有留下姓名的執行者：被徵募的降卒、押運俘虜的郡兵、趨船的船工，以及在番禺、始安一線籌措糧秣的倉曹。對這次遠征的將領，《隋書》只留下官號與姓氏，未記其年歲與籍貫；對島上各部首長更是連姓名都沒有留下，這段歷史留下的名字比留下的空白更少。
peopleEn: The order to send the expedition came from Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang. At the time he had just received the envoys of the western regions at Zhangye and Yanzhi, was in the middle of building the eastern capital and the Grand Canal, and was about to turn his arms against Goguryeo; a campaign against Ryukyu was, in his mind, a victory that could be spent on advertising the mandate of heaven. The commander in the field was Chen Leng, formerly an officer of the Southern Chen court who came over to Sui after Chen's fall and rose to the rank of General of the Martial Guard; this time he commanded the combined sea and land force and led the landing. Liu Bao, General of the Tiger's Might, and Zhu Zhiliang, General of the Zhou Division, were likewise old officers of the south who had surrendered to Sui, each leading his own contingent in support of the shipborne movement. On the island side the leading figures were the Ryukyu king and the heads of the island's communities; the History of Sui records only that the Sui army seized their king and does not preserve the king's name, and in the fighting the king and a number of headmen were killed or captured. Far more numerous in this war were the people who left no name at all: the recruited levies, the commandery soldiers who escorted the prisoners, the crews who worked the ships, and the warehouse officials along the Panyu and Shian line who gathered the grain. For its commanders the History of Sui keeps only the style of office and the surname, recording neither their years nor their native places; of the island headmen it keeps not even a name, and this stretch of history preserves fewer names than blanks.
kits: 本卡兵器是羅馬短劍 gladius，屬地中海世界護手直身短刺兵的一族：劍身雙刃平直、長約六十厘米，圓盤形護手把握柄與刃身隔開，重心靠近手部，專為在盾牌的邊緣與縫隙之間直刺而設計，並不是用來揮砍。隋軍在同一位置上的兵器是環首刀，刀身單刃直行、刀鐶作圓環，通長約七十至八十厘米，懸掛在左腰，隋唐墓葬出土的環首刀與墓室壁畫都可見其形制，斬擊與直刺並用，功能上與羅馬短劍最為接近。登島作戰的隋軍步卒配大盾與步盾護住身體正面，遠射用臂弓、蹶張弩與床弩，近身長兵器有槊與矛，騎兵用北方馬匹，攜環首刀與長槊。水軍以艨艟、鬥艦與平底運船組成投送力量，另備海船，應對島嶼近岸的淺水、礁石與潮汐。島民一方則以木製防具、竹製長矛與弓箭為主，未見成片的金屬甲胄，武器上的差距集中在護身與刺穿能力兩點，這正是隋軍登岸後最占便宜的地方。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman gladius, a member of the Mediterranean family of straight, short thrusting swords with a hand guard: a double-edged blade, straight and about sixty centimetres long, with a disc-shaped guard separating grip from blade and the balance carried close to the hand, designed above all to thrust past the edge of a shield rather than to swing. The Sui equivalent in the same functional slot was the ring-pommel dao, a single-edged straight blade with a ring-shaped pommel, some seventy to eighty centimetres long, worn hanging at the left hip; examples excavated from Sui and Tang tombs and wall paintings in tombs show the form, and it was used for both cutting and stabbing, making it the closest functional cousin of the Roman short sword. Sui foot soldiers who landed on the island carried large and small shields to cover the front of the body; long-range fire came from the single bow, the powerful crossbow drawn by the feet, and the bed crossbow; long thrusting weapons were the spear and the great lance; the mounted men rode northern horses and carried the ring-pommel dao and the long spear. The naval force was built from armoured and fighting galleys together with flat-bottomed transports, with seagoing vessels also held in readiness to meet the shallows, reefs and tides of the island shore. The islanders on their side relied on wooden protection, bamboo lances and bows, with no body of metal armour in sight; the gap in weapons came down to two things, protection of the body and the ability to pierce, and those were precisely where the Sui advantage was greatest once the landing was made.
tactics: 整場遠征採取的是水軍載兵、島嶼登陸、輕兵先鋒破障、重兵壓上的序列。船隊自廣州放洋，經雷州半島一線的臺州轉泊，趕在東南海上颱風最盛的時節之前橫渡；途中遇逆風與大浪，艦隊收斂結隊，改以小舟先導探路，抵近島嶼後再分批登岸。隋軍沒有正面強攻國主所在的聚落與城寨，而是先以死士乘小舟分批上岸，控制灘頭、佔領村道，切斷島上各聚落之間的聯絡，再以弩陣在遠處壓制、以長槊列在前排掩護持盾短兵推進。短兵接觸時，用的正是羅馬短劍那一套原理：左手持盾護住身體正面，右手環首刀直刺，靠盾邊與刺突的節奏取勝，而不是靠劈砍。海島地形狹窄，房屋與樹林限制了縱深，使這種近身刺擊的節奏比中原的野戰更容易發揮。船隊在島嶼東岸覓得泊地之後，隋軍並沒有把五萬五千人一次卸上灘頭，而是分批建立灘頭堡，昼間封鎖村道、夜間巡守，穩定下來才把重裝與糧秣移上島。
tacticsEn: The whole expedition followed the sequence of troop transport by sea, landing on the island, a light vanguard breaking the way and the main body pressing in behind. The fleet set out from Panyu, refitted at Tai prefecture along the Leizhou peninsula line, and crossed before the typhoon season of the southern ocean reached its height; meeting contrary wind and heavy swell on the way, the ships closed up into a close order while small boats were sent ahead to sound the route, and only in the vicinity of the island did the troops come ashore in batches. The Sui army did not assault the king's settlement and its defences head on. Instead picked men rode out in small boats and landed by instalments, seizing the beachheads, taking the village paths, and cutting the island's settlements off from one another; volleys of crossbow bolts held the islanders at a distance, long spears were carried in the front ranks to cover the short-sword men with their shields, and those were pressed forward. In the hand-to-hand fighting the principle was exactly that of the Roman gladius: the shield hand guarded the front of the body, the right hand thrust the ring-pommel dao, and the result came from the edge of the shield and the rhythm of the thrust rather than from chopping. The narrow ground of an island, with its houses and its stands of timber cutting off any depth, suited this rhythm of close stabbing far better than the open battlefields of the Chinese plain. After the fleet found anchorage on the eastern side of the island, the Sui did not put all 55,000 men ashore at once: they built beachheads in batches, closed the village paths by day and patrolled by night, and only moved the heavy equipment and the grain ashore once the position was stable.
data: 兵力方面，《隋書·東夷傳》記隋軍將兵及募降卒五萬五千人，主將三人為武衛將軍陳棱、虎威將軍劉寶、周師將軍朱智良。戰果記擒其國主，並虜二萬餘人、斬首萬餘級。航程方面，自廣州至流求，按兩地經緯度折算約一千五百公里，約八百海里；今人考證流求國在琉球群島，以沖繩本島為主，隋軍的登陸點與國主所在城邑尚有爭議，一般指本島南部首里一帶。時間方面，史書只記大業六年（610年）出兵與凱旋，未載確切月份；參照同年西巡、會盟、征交州與其後征高句麗的次第推想，應在夏秋之間，本卡所列月份只是為方便索引的估計。糧秣數量、戰船艘數與雙方兵力損失，《隋書》均未記載，後世多不作臆測。《隋書》另記流求國在島上分為數十國，各有首長，說明這並非單一城邦，而是多部族共存的島嶼聯盟，戰後的羈縻安排也必須逐部分別處理。
dataEn: On strength, the History of Sui, in the section on the Eastern Barbarians, records that the Sui force comprised 55,000 men in arms and recruited levies, with three commanders named: General of the Martial Guard Chen Leng, General of the Tiger's Might Liu Bao and General of the Zhou Division Zhu Zhiliang. On results it records the seizure of the king, the taking of more than 20,000 prisoners and the cutting off of more than 10,000 heads. On distance: from Panyu to Ryukyu comes to roughly 1,500 kilometres, some 800 nautical miles, by the modern calculation from the coordinates of the two places; modern scholarship places Ryukyu in the Ryukyu Islands, principally the main island of Okinawa, while the landing place of the Sui troops and the site of the king's settlement remain disputed, and are generally taken to lie in the southern part of the island around Shuri. On timing: the histories record only the dispatch and the return in the sixth year of the Daye reign, 610, and give no exact month; judged against the western tour, the assembly of envoys, the campaign against Jiaozhi and the later war against Goguryeo in the same period, the expedition most likely fell between summer and autumn, and the month entered on this card is only an estimate made for indexing. The quantities of grain, the number of ships and the losses on both sides are not recorded in the History of Sui, and later writers have generally declined to guess at them. The History of Sui also records that Ryukyu was divided on the island into a number of states, each with its own headman, which shows that this was not a single city-state but an island league of several peoples; the loose control established after the war therefore had to be worked out group by group.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一是帝國的天下秩序觀：隋朝把東海上的島國視為異域，遠征流求被當作宣示天威、把它納入羈縻的舉動，與此同時的西巡、會盟與接待萬國使屬於同一套帝王外交的邏輯。第二是通道：番禺、始安一帶的造船場與水軍經驗，集中了能夠支撐橫渡東海南部的船工、舟師與對海路的實地記憶，此前平林邑、交趾的遠征已經把這條海上通道走通。第三是人力與財政的考量：隋朝正傾力營建東都與大運河、籌備大舉征高句麗，一場對手規模不大的島國遠征，可以用一次可控的勝利來裝點武功，為更大的消耗預先製造聲望。此外，隋朝剛在西巡中接見萬國使，海外來朝的使團越來越多，朝廷需要一個能夠向遠方來客展示的海上勝利，這一點從出兵的時機上看得最清楚。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the fighting. First, the imperial vision of world order: the Sui court regarded the island kingdom in the eastern sea as a place outside the civilised world, and the expedition against Ryukyu was meant to display the weight of heaven and to bring the island within the loose bonds of the empire, the same logic that governed the western tour, the assembly of envoys and the reception of the envoys from the many states in the same years. Second, the route: the yards at Panyu and Shian and the accumulated seamanship of the southern fleets concentrated there the shipwrights, pilots and practical knowledge of the eastern and southern sea needed to cross it, and the earlier campaigns against Linyi and Jiaozhi had already opened that sea lane. Third, manpower and money: the Sui state was straining every resource to build the eastern capital and the Grand Canal and to prepare the great campaign against Goguryeo, and a war against a small island kingdom, with a result that could be kept under control, allowed the court to adorn its martial reputation and to bank credit in advance of the far greater drain to come. Besides, having just received the envoys of the many states during the western tour, and with more and more overseas missions arriving at court, the government needed a naval victory it could display to envoys from afar, and that is clearest of all in the timing of the dispatch.
impact: 這是中國正史中第一次對琉球大規模的軍事行動，其後隋朝在島上推行羈縻安排，琉球國開始以藩屬身分遣使入朝，隋朝也藉此取得東南海上的地理知識與方物。長期看，俘獲的島民被押回大陸、編入番禺等地的官府安置並令其耕種，島上人口與技術沿著這條路線流向閩粵沿海，構成了今日福建、廣東與琉球之間人員往來與航海技術交流的一條早期通道。制度上，此役把海外羈縻變成可操作的軍事程序：渡海投送、先鋒登岸、破城擒王、押俘安置，唐高宗龍朔年間再征流求時幾乎照搬同一套路。但局限同樣清楚：遠征沒有常駐機構與制度隨軍，隋亡之後中原對琉球的直接介入隨之中斷，這條通道也再度沉寂。這條通道在隋末唐初一度中斷，但南北往來的商船與使節把島上的物產、工藝與航海知識逐步帶進沿海，後來唐代的多次征流求與冊封使節也都沿著同一條海路走。
impactEn: This was the first large-scale military action against Ryukyu recorded in the Chinese official histories. In its wake the Sui established administrative arrangements for loose control on the island, Ryukyu began to send envoys to court as a vassal, and the Sui in turn acquired geographic knowledge and products from the eastern and southern sea. In the longer term, the islanders who were taken and brought back to the mainland were registered under the authorities at Panyu and elsewhere and set to work the land, so that population and technique moved along this line to the coasts of Fujian and Guangdong, forming one of the earliest channels for the movement of people and seamanship between present-day Fujian, Guangdong and Ryukyu. Institutionally, the campaign turned the loose control of overseas lands into an operable military procedure: sea-borne lift, a vanguard landing, the seizure of the settlement and the king, the escorting of prisoners back, and settlement. When the Tang under Gaozong renewed the campaign against Ryukyu in the longyue years, the same sequence was very nearly copied. The limits were equally clear: no permanent offices or institutions followed the expedition overseas, and once the Sui fell, direct Sui presence in Ryukyu ended, and the channel fell silent once more. The channel fell quiet for a time in the transition from Sui to Tang, but merchant ships and envoys running north and south carried the products, the crafts and the seamanship of the island gradually into the coastal ports, and the later Tang campaigns against Ryukyu and the investiture envoys all travelled the same sea road.
result: 隋軍攻破了流求島的防禦，擒獲國主與島上首長，俘虜二萬餘人，斬首萬餘級，島國第一次被中原王朝的軍隊直接登陸佔領。佔領之後，隋軍把俘虜押回大陸，編入番禺等地的官府安置，授以田器令其耕種；大軍隨後報捷還朝，隋煬帝在洛陽會見西南夷諸使時以此為榮。流求國此後遣使朝貢，成為隋朝在東海上的一個藩屬，直到隋朝崩潰才告中斷。戰役的代價同樣記在帳上：五萬五千人渡海作戰、往返的水路、募兵與糧秣的耗用，都是隋朝在人力與財政上的一次大出血。六年之後，隋朝在征高句麗的戰場上全面崩潰，天下隨之大亂，流求方向的朝貢與航海通道也在往後的動盪中停滯，直到唐代的龍朔年間才以另一種形式重新接上。從技術上看，這一役也留下了一份水軍的記錄：五萬五千人分乘船隊渡海、登岸、破城、押回俘虜並維持補給，全程靠海路完成，是隋代水軍投送能力的一次實測。
resultEn: The Sui army broke through the defences of Ryukyu, seized the king and the headmen of the island, took more than 20,000 prisoners and cut off more than 10,000 heads; for the first time the island kingdom was occupied by the army of a Chinese dynasty. After the occupation the Sui escorted the prisoners back to the mainland, registered them under the authorities at Panyu and gave them farm tools to work the soil; the main force then reported its victory and returned to court, and Emperor Yang of Sui was proud of it when he received the envoys of the south-western peoples at Luoyang. Ryukyu thereafter sent tribute missions and became one of the Sui's vassals on the eastern sea, until the collapse of the dynasty broke the link. The cost was entered in the ledger as well: 55,000 men carried to sea and back, the water road in both directions, the recruiting and the grain consumed, a serious bleeding of Sui manpower and finance. Six years later the Sui unravelled completely on the battlefields of Goguryeo, the empire broke up, and the tribute and the sea lane running towards Ryukyu stalled in the disorder that followed, until the longyue years of the Tang picked the thread up again in another form. From a technical point of view the campaign also left a record of naval warfare: 55,000 men carried to sea in a fleet, landed, storming the settlement, escorting the prisoners home and sustaining supply, the whole operation completed by the sea road, a practical test of the Sui navy as a lift force.
